EasyTier Compose

Unofficial F-Droid repository for EasyTier Compose, an Android client for the EasyTier decentralized mesh VPN. Built from https://github.com/maksimkurb/EasyTierCompose.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://maksimkurb.github.io/EasyTierCompose/fdroid/repo
